stop_rule: Stop each conversation on runtime error or pending owner input; retain every attempt, no replacement successes.
grading: Strict production summary/schema/source validation. Returned turns are completion counts, not task-quality successes.
measurement: run_turn wall time; load waits and synchronous summaries counted separately with individual duration_ms; background calls excluded from foreground duration. Check whether commit includes any synchronous summary; TurnCompleted is emitted after commit.
baseline: evals/latency/summary_budget_serial_capture.json; historical prompt and summary mechanism differ, not a causal A/B
